You are starting a new project from this template.

Input I will provide:

- Organization mission
- Audience
- Page/content outline
- Any visual direction notes

Use this repo's standards and docs to implement the first production-ready draft.

Required process:

1. Read README.md, docs/STANDARDS.md, docs/WCAG_2.2_CHECKLIST.md, and docs/RESEND_SETUP.md.
2. Scaffold required pages and sections with reusable components.
3. Keep everything accessible and keyboard navigable.
4. Keep styles tokenized and theme-aware.
5. Add tests for new utility logic.
6. Run npm run validate and fix failures.
7. Summarize what was built and list any remaining decisions.

Output format:

- What was implemented
- Which files changed
- Validation command results
- Follow-up questions for the project owner
